::api-operation{method="GET" path="/v1/webhook_endpoints/{id}"}
#docs
The signing secret is never returned here — only at create and rotate_secret.

## Path parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | `string` | **yes** | The webhook endpoint's id. |

## Response

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `object` | `string` | The object type. |
| `id` | `string` | The webhook endpoint's id (whe_…). |
| `url` | `string` | The URL that receives the webhooks. |
| `business` | `string` | Business scope; null = receives all of the org’s events in this endpoint’s partition. |
| `livemode` | `string` | The endpoint's partition. An endpoint only ever receives events from businesses in its own partition; org-level events (no business) reach both. Immutable. One of `test`, `live`. |
| `signing_secret` | `string` | Returned once at creation; verify deliveries with HMAC-SHA256. |
| `enabled` | `boolean` | Whether the endpoint receives webhooks. |

## Status codes

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `200` | Success |
| `404` | No such webhook endpoint |

#request
```bash [Request]
curl "$TMBILLING_URL/v1/webhook_endpoints/whe_XXXXXXXXXXXX01" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TMBILLING_API_KEY"
```

#response
:::code-group
```json [200 OK]
{
  "object": "webhook_endpoint",
  "id": "whe_XXXXXXXXXXXX01",
  "url": "https://example.com/webhooks/billing",
  "business": "biz_XXXXXXXXXXXX01",
  "livemode": "test",
  "signing_secret": "whsec_XXXXXXXXXXXX01",
  "enabled": false
}
```
```json [404 Not Found]
{
  "error": {
    "type": "invalid_request_error",
    "message": "No such webhook endpoint"
  }
}
```
